items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: They took him on the bass

ctx.x: He got a little jazz from Rene. Yeah. That's where he got it from. And I was telling Mr. Russell, you remember after Rene was kind of going down. I had to play this jippie dance. His wife. She live in Rapshap. Yeah. She calls me and says take Henry to learn the music without checking. Yeah. When him and son used to come over. Yeah son Thomas. Yeah. Fan joke there. Uh huh. And I start him off that he could read his reviews. Yeah. That's right. That's right. And the same time then Joe got interested. He never could…

I remember Joe started with the clarinet for that. Because he had no son and Rene and it was strange. Yeah. Yeah. And uh uh the old man Rene uh uh Guernie was playing bass with him first. See. Mmhmm. With Rene. He started with Rene. After that he they had a fallen out and then that's where they take me. And uh after I had broke up with him then they take him to Chester. Is that Chester's artist? Chester's artist. They took him on the bass and they had uh him and Rene had to run in again then he come back and got…

Well you know Rene had taken Simon too. Yeah. Simon Moreira. When you had a Bitskin band came in. Huh? When you had a Bitskin band came in. What band? Bitskin. Yeah. You know a Zuta band you call it. Oh you're talking about uh. You're talking about uh.
